styles.name: pong
styles.description: Pong: two paddles rally a square ball over a dashed net; blocky score digits count up with progress

styles.name: breakout
styles.description: Breakout: red/orange brick rows above a paddle and bouncing ball; bricks knocked out = progress

styles.name: asteroids
styles.description: Asteroids: vector-wireframe rocks shatter as progress rises; a ship remains

styles.name: missile-command
styles.description: Missile Command: enemy warheads streak down toward six cities while the central base's counter-missiles burst into fireballs; incoming missiles destroyed = progress

styles.name: centipede
styles.description: Centipede: a segmented bug with antennae wiggles through a mushroom field while the gnome shoots it down; segments shot = progress

styles.name: adventure
styles.description: Adventure: the square hero carries the arrow-sword toward a crenellated castle, a duck-like dragon on his heels; the portcullis rises with progress

styles.name: pitfall
styles.description: Pitfall!: Harry swings on a vine over a tar pit under the jungle canopy; trees scroll by and the underground tunnel fills with progress

styles.name: combat
styles.description: Combat: two treaded tanks face off across barrier walls trading shells; the score digits count hits as progress grows

styles.name: kaboom
styles.description: Kaboom!: the grinning Mad Bomber paces the wall dropping lit bombs into two stacked water buckets; the catch counter = progress

styles.name: yars-revenge
styles.description: Yars' Revenge: the winged Yar hovers by the flickering neutral zone while the Qotile's cell shield erodes; erosion = progress

styles.name: lunar-lander
styles.description: Lunar Lander: a vector wireframe lander descends; altitude/fuel = progress
